target_customer: Clinicians and patients with chronic liver disease needing staging without biopsy
problem: Staging liver fibrosis and NASH requires an invasive biopsy.
business_model: Diagnostic test development (non-invasive liver fibrosis and NASH test)

founders.name: Storm Stillman
founders.background_notes: Later CEO of Curebase (S18) per YC page

technical_complexity.rationale: Developing and validating a biomarker diagnostic against biopsy requires clinical data and regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: Collected biochemical data was the asset, though validated alternatives like blood panels existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: DiscernDx, a precision medicine company, acquired Luminist Labs on 29 April 2020 to fold its data into a multi-omics platform; terms were not disclosed.

market_need_then: Not sourced for 2016; the YC page frames the need as replacing biopsy for NASH diagnosis.

branding.domain_note: luministlabs.com (spelled Luminist) now redirects to a HugeDomains sale page.

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand; the domain is for sale.

outcome_analysis: Luminist Labs was a New York diagnostics startup in YC Winter 2016 working on a non-invasive test for liver fibrosis and NASH. DiscernDx acquired it in April 2020 to use its collected data. Funding is unknown, so whether this was a strong outcome or an asset sale cannot be judged. The CEO went on to lead Curebase.
notes: Village.ai lists AME Cloud, Khosla, Morado and YC as investors and Tracxn a 120K seed; unverified aggregators, no Form D found, so no rounds recorded. Founding year given as 2014, 2015 or 2016 by different sources. Website is dead (domain for sale). Competitor search returned only current literature, so the list is empty.
